title: OpenHands
intro: The OpenHands CLI, headless over `openhands --headless --json`, on any litellm provider through `LLM_MODEL`, `LLM_API_KEY` and `LLM_BASE_URL`.
notes: Needs Python 3.12, hence the `py312` sandbox. The first start is slow (it unpacks and initializes); `run.timeout_s` is raised to allow it.
The conversation id is derived from the platform session as a UUID and passed as `--resume` on every turn, so turn one creates it and later turns continue it.
`openai/<model>` for a chat or Responses provider; `anthropic/<model>` with a base without `/v1` for an Anthropic one.
